05-31-1508 is May 31, 1508.  
18 weeks + 7 days = 19 weeks = 133 days.  
Subtract 133 days from May 31, 1508.  
May has 31 days, so April 30 is 31 days earlier, March 31 is 61 days earlier, etc.  
133 days before May 31, 1508:  
Back up 31 days to May 1 → 101 days left.  
April (30 days) → March 2 (71 days left).  
March (31 days) → February 1 (40 days left).  
January (31 days) → December 31, 1507 (9 days left).  
December 31 back 9 days = December 22, 1507.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1507-12-22
